raw.description:
Summary

Our Product Strategy team shapes the future of Guidewire’s analytics and pricing solutions for the global P&C insurance market, with a particular focus on AI-powered pricing, rating, and underwriting products. We operate at the intersection of product, data science, and customer needs, ensuring our platform is secure, scalable, and delivers measurable value to insurers worldwide. You’ll join a collaborative, fast-paced environment that blends deep insurance expertise with cutting-edge cloud and AI capabilities.

As a Senior Actuarial Consultant, you will lead complex predictive modeling and actuarial analyses that inform our product roadmap and help customers unlock value from Guidewire’s analytics and pricing solutions. You’ll partner directly with insurers, product managers, sales, and professional services to translate actuarial insight into practical, high-impact business solutions. This role is ideal for a P&C actuary who enjoys both hands-on modeling and consultative, customer-facing work in a dynamic, AI-enhanced product environment.

This position requires advanced statistical modeling skills, strong communication skills, project management, planning and organizational skills. This person must be able to prioritize, take initiative and solve problems under pressure. The ideal candidate will be able to effectively explain modelling concepts in an educational/consultative manner to external (and internal) customers that are not as analytically sophisticated in addition to those that are very sophisticated.

Job Description

What you’ll do

  • Advise insurers and internal stakeholders on the design, interpretation, and application of advanced analytics in pricing, risk rating, and operational modeling, connecting actuarial insights to clear business outcomes.

  • Experience using statistical modeling tools such as Emblem, DataRobot, Akur8, Earnix, SAS or others. Python and R modeling are not required but are a plus.

  • Analyze customer data for statistical validity and credibility, including data quality, segmentation, and model performance, ensuring that outputs are robust, explainable, and aligned with insurance best practices.

  • Partner with Sales and Go-To-Market teams to support prospect and renewal conversations, including discovery, presentation of analytical findings, and responding to detailed actuarial and technical questions.

  • Lead or contribute to client-facing meetings, workshops, and presentations—simplifying sophisticated modeling concepts for diverse audiences while also engaging deeply with highly technical stakeholders.

  • Provide structured feedback to Product Management and Product Strategy on customer needs, emerging actuarial methods, and opportunities to embed AI, cloud, and data capabilities in our pricing and analytics products, including new categories like Pricing/Rating and Underwriting.

  • Collaborate across Product Strategy, Product Development & Operations, and Professional Services to help ensure our solutions are secure, scalable, and measurably improve customer outcomes, including international expansion efforts and AI-enabled features.

  • Work with data from multiple sources using SQL and, where helpful, Python or R, ensuring data is ready for modeling and aligned with Guidewire’s standards for accuracy, governance, and auditability.

  • At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

What you’ll bring
Required

  • Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.

  • 7–12 years of actuarial experience in property and casualty insurance and/or actuarial consulting, with a focus on pricing, portfolio analysis, or related analytics.

  • Deep experience with statistical modeling tools such as Emblem, DataRobot, Akur8, Earnix, SAS, or equivalent, with comfort evaluating and comparing different modeling approaches.

  • Strong knowledge of P&C insurance underwriting, risk selection, and pricing practices, including experience analyzing portfolios for profit and loss and performance drivers.

  • Proven ability to translate actuarial and modeling concepts into practical business language for non-technical stakeholders, both in writing and in presentations.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills, with experience leading client-facing discussions, workshops, or steering sessions.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize under pressure, and operate independently while collaborating effectively in a cross-functional, global environment.

  • Experience working with data using SQL and an analytical mindset committed to data quality, validation, and traceability.

  • Ability to travel up to 10%, within the USA and internationally, for customer meetings, workshops, and internal collaboration.

Preferred

  • ACAS or FCAS strongly preferred; near-ACAS candidates with substantial relevant experience will be considered. CSPA is a plus.

  • Hands-on experience using Python or R for actuarial or predictive modeling, experimentation, or data preparation.

  • Prior experience with pricing or rating platforms, rating engines, or insurance software implementations.

  • Background working with cloud-based or AI-enabled analytics products, or experience partnering with product and engineering teams to shape features.

  • Experience supporting international markets (for example, London, continental Europe, Japan, or Australia) and understanding of regional pricing and regulatory nuances.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $145,000 - $217,000 . Your base pay will depend on your experience, skills, education, training, and location among other factors. All full-time positions or part-time roles working 30 hours or more a week at Guidewire are eligible for benefits that support their health and well-being including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a company sponsored retirement plan. In addition, some roles may be eligible for the annual company bonus plan, commissions, and/or long term incentive awards which are contingent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, company and employee performance.

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

raw.description:
About Mathspace

Mathspace is a cutting-edge eLearning platform delivering enriching, personalised mathematics content to thousands of schools worldwide. Students receive step-by-step feedback and guidance, and our interactive content adapts to each learner’s proficiency while providing educators with data-driven insights to guide student growth. Mathspace is an online mathematics program used by students from primary school through higher education , with a mission to transform the traditional one-size-fits-all math textbook into an engaging, adaptive learning journey.

About the Role

We are looking for an IB Curriculum Content Project Manager to lead the creation and refinement of our International Baccalaureate (IB) mathematics textbooks for both the Middle Years Programme (MYP) and Diploma Programme (DP). In this 12-month contract role (fully remote), you will leverage your deep understanding of the IB curriculum to ensure our content is pedagogically sound, fully aligned with IB standards, and of the highest quality. You will project manage the end-to-end content development process, coordinating a team of writers and editors, planning content delivery, performing detailed reviews, and continually improving our workflow with the latest tech and AI tools.

This role is ideal for an experienced IB educator or curriculum developer who is also tech-savvy. You will play a critical part in shaping world-class IB math resources that empower teachers and students globally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Content Development: Oversee the end-to-end creation of IB MYP & DP mathematics textbook content, from initial planning through final publication. Manage project timelines, set milestones, and ensure the content development stays on track.
  • Curriculum Alignment: Ensure all lessons, examples, and practice questions are tightly aligned with IB curriculum requirements and reflect the depth and breadth of the IB MYP and DP syllabi. The goal is to cover all required topics with appropriate rigor and IB-specific approaches (e.g. inquiry-based learning, real-world contexts).
  • Content Review & Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough reviews of content produced by the team (including lessons, questions, solutions, and explanatory materials). Provide detailed, specific feedback to authors on how to improve clarity, pedagogical effectiveness, and alignment. Your review comments will guide the internal team in making edits to meet our high standards of accuracy, clarity, and IB-style educational quality.
  • Team Coordination: Work closely with a team of content developers, educators, and editors. Facilitate collaboration and communication across the team, ensuring everyone understands the project goals and quality expectations. Mentor content writers in best practices for IB curriculum design.
  • Process Improvement & AI Integration: Continuously refine our content development and review processes to improve efficiency and quality. Be proactive in leveraging technology and AI tools (e.g. content generation and analysis tools) to aid in creating and reviewing materials. For example, use AI to help generate draft questions or check alignment, and integrate new tools to streamline workflows. Being comfortable with the latest ed-tech and AI tools is a must for maximizing productivity.
  • Final Quality Ownership: Before content is released, ensure that each unit/chapter meets a “world-class” quality standard: fact-checked, pedagogically sound, engaging for students, and polished in language and presentation. Ultimately, you are the guardian of quality for our IB math textbooks, ensuring that Mathspace’s IB offerings can serve as comprehensive stand-alone resources for schools .

Requirements

  • IB Curriculum Expertise: Extensive knowledge of the IB mathematics curriculum for MYP and DP. Ideally, at least a few years of experience teaching IB MYP and/or DP Mathematics, or experience in developing IB-aligned curriculum materials. You should be intimately familiar with IB objectives, assessment criteria, and the style of IB math problems.
  • Content Development Experience: Strong background in educational content creation – for example, writing or editing math textbook chapters, lesson plans, or exam-style questions. You understand how to scaffold concepts and design practice problems that build understanding.
  • Project Management Skills: Excellent organisational and project management abilities. Experience leading projects or teams in an education or publishing context is highly valued (e.g. managing a curriculum writing project or publishing a textbook). You can break down large tasks, meet deadlines, and coordinate others’ work effectively.
  • Tech Savvy & AI Proficiency: High comfort with technology and quick to adapt to new tools. Willingness to use and experiment with modern AI tools to enhance productivity and content quality is essential. You don’t need to be a programmer, but you should be eager to utilise software to work smarter. Experience with tools like LaTeX or other math authoring software is also beneficial .
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills – especially in writing clear, constructive feedback. Ability to work collaboratively in a remote team, coordinate meetings or discussions across time zones, and share knowledge with colleagues. You can articulate what makes good educational content and guide others to achieve it.
  • Detail Orientation and Quality Focus: Meticulous attention to detail when it comes to academic accuracy, formatting, and consistency. A passion for maintaining high quality standards. You care about the student learning experience and will insist on clarity and correctness in every piece of content.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Educational Publishing Experience: Prior experience in a curriculum publishing role or as an editor for math educational content. Familiarity with the processes of textbook publishing, such as peer review, copyediting, and layout considerations.
  • Assessment and Exam Insight: Experience writing or grading mathematics exams (for IB or other curricula) can be helpful, as it gives insight into exam-style question quality and common student pitfalls .
  • Coding/Tools: Basic experience with programming or data tools (e.g. Python or SQL) isn’t required but could be useful in working with our system or analysing content usage data . Similarly, experience using LaTeX for mathematical content formatting is an advantage.

Benefits

  • Remote Work & Flexibility: This role is fully remote – work from home with flexible hours. We value work-life balance and can accommodate flexible arrangements .
  • Collaborative, Impactful Culture: Join a relaxed, friendly team environment where your contributions directly impact teachers and students across the world . We foster creativity and teamwork, with the shared goal of improving math education globally.
  • Professional Growth: You’ll be at the forefront of integrating AI and innovative practices in education. This is an opportunity to lead a high-profile project and further develop leadership skills in curriculum development.
  • Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a mission to deliver better learning experiences. Your work will help shape a comprehensive IB math resource used by schools internationally, truly making a difference in classrooms.

If you are passionate about the IB curriculum and excited about harnessing technology to create outstanding educational content, we’d love to hear from you. Come help us shape the future of IB mathematics learning with Mathspace!

raw.description:
A-Players is a fully remote company with a mission to help impact-driven companies succeed more than profit-driven ones.

We are hiring aCustomer Operations Associatefor one of our U.S.-based clients in the e-commerce and influencer marketing industry. This startup is rapidly scaling, and the CS team is transitioning from a fully manual support model to a hybrid product–automation, operations system. Currently, they are looking for a hyper-organized, systems-obsessed project manager to own and evolve the operational workflows behind our campaign launches.

This isn’t a typical coordination role—this is the person who will design, manage, and improve the end-to-end launch system that the startup's future software will ultimately automate.

You will map processes, spot inefficiencies, build automations, and partner closely with Product to ensure our internal workflows inform the evolution of our platform. Your job is to run today’s launch machine while helping architect the version that will eventually live inside the company's product.

If you’ve ever looked at a manual process and immediately thought, “This should be automated—let me rebuild it the right way first,” this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full lifecycle—from deadlines to dependencies to handoffs—and ensure each step runs predictably and on time. You’ll manage campaign launches the way a PM manages sprints: with rigor, clarity, and accountability.

  • Maintain and evolve the Airtable Campaign Dashboard as our operational “source of truth,” while continuously identifying what should become a future product feature, workflow, or automation.

  • You will help bridge the gap between how the CS team operates today and what their software will automate tomorrow.

  • You won’t just follow workflows—you will redesign them. Identify friction points, rebuild systems for scale, and create automations that reduce manual work across CS, Product Ops, Creator Support, and Fulfillment.

  • Your frontline insights into campaign operations will help shape future product enhancements. You will proactively propose:

    • workflow automations

    • UI/UX improvements

    • system rules

    • data structures

    • triggers

    • user journeys

  • You take over the admin-heavy workflows—client reminders, tracking, scheduling, dashboard updates—so CS managers focus on strategy, not task execution.

  • You ensure no step is missed, no deadline slips, and all cross-functional teams operate with full visibility.

Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in English — C1 level spoken and written.

  • 1–3 years of experience in project management, operations, or CS/Product Ops.

  • Proven ownership of end-to-end workflows with deadlines, dependencies, and handoffs.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Airtable as an operational system of record.

  • Experience designing and improving processes, workflows, and automations.

  • Systems- and product-minded: able to translate ops pain points into scalable solutions.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and reliability — nothing slips.

  • Clear, structured communicator comfortable working cross-functionally.

  • Willingness to complete the A-Players Startup Training Program as part of the onboarding and development process.

Soft Skills

  • Systems thinker with the ability to zoom out and design end-to-end workflows.

  • High ownership and autonomy — able to propose solutions, not just execute tasks.

  • Strong communication, clarity, and ability to align multiple stakeholders.

  • Problem-solving mindset and comfort working under fast-paced, dynamic conditions.

  • Detail-oriented and structured — strong documentation discipline.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience in influencer marketing, e-commerce operations, or EdTech.

  • Experience working closely with product/technical teams.

Why Join This Project

  • Performance-Based Growth: Competitive salary with annual reviews tied to your impact.

  • Supportive Environment: Work with a team that values your ideas and expertise.

  • Generous Time Off: 20 paid vacation days + unlimited sick leave.

  • Learning Opportunities: Join internal workshops and skill-building sessions.

  • Exclusive Resources: Access our Internal Library and premium tools.

  • Skill Development: Comprehensive training to grow both hard and soft skills.

Recruiting Flow

  1. Initial interview with the Team Lead.

  2. Take-home test assignment.

  3. In-depth interview with our CEO (optional).

  4. Offer.

  5. A-Players Startup Training Program.

  6. Reference check.

What Is the Startup Training Program?

Our training is a 2-week, hands-on onboarding phase designed to help you succeed from day one.

During this time, you’ll:

  • Work on real tasks reflecting startup operations — lead research, outreach, and CRM tracking.

  • Receive daily assignments via your personal task board and individual feedback.

  • Learn A-Players' level standards for communication, organization, and client support.

  • Develop your understanding of startup workflows, AI tools, and growth funnels.

  • Gain mentorship from the A-Players' core team and connect with fellow Associates.

  • Upon successful completion, you’ll receive a Certificate of Completion.

⭐️ The training is not a test — it’s your launchpad for mastering the skills needed to collaborate effectively with U.S. founders and fast-growing startups.

Note: Salary for this position depends on your experience and the results of the test assignment.

Description

This position in Sargent & Lundy’s Consulting group will require you to focus on our utility planning and advisory projects, such as the following:

  • Transmission system planning and analysis, including studies in load flow, stability, short circuit, and electromagnetic transients (EMT), to support a variety of clients such as ISO/RTO and electric utilities.
  • Preparing new generator interconnection applications, including development of conceptual single line diagram, verification of compliance with reactive power requirements, and development of steady-state, dynamic, and short circuit models to support the applications.
  • Reviewing ISO feasibility and system impact studies to provide guidance to our clients, who are ISO Interconnection Customers.

This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within the United States.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential skills and experience:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering and sufficient industry experience is considered in lieu of an advanced degree
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant power systems engineering experience with utility or consultant
  • Experience in load flow and contingency analysis to identify transmission thermal and voltage constraints and to identify transfer capability limits
  • Experience using transmission planning software for load flow modeling, contingency analysis, and stability analysis using PSS/E, PSLF, TARA

Valued but not required skills and experience:

  • Experience in stability analysis to identify critical clearing times, identify voltage constraints and analyze power system damping
  • Experience in electromagnetic transient analysis using PSCAD
  • Experience in short circuit analysis and using software programs CAPE or ASPEN

raw.title: Growth Analytics Lead (Individual Contributor)
raw.excerpt: Want your work to directly influence how a 9-figure brand invests millions in growth?
raw.description:
Want your work to directly influence how a 9-figure brand invests millions in growth?

Freebird® is a high-growth DTC brand redefining shaving for millions of people. We have served over 2 million customers and scaled to 9 figures in revenue.

We are entering our next phase of profitable scale and are looking for a hands-on Growth Analytics leader to build and run the intelligence engine behind it.

This is not a reporting-only role.

This is a commercial analytics role at the core of the business.

You will build the models, dashboards, and decision frameworks that determine where we scale, where we pull back, and how we increase long-term contribution margin per cohort.

Your work will directly influence marketing investment, CAC guardrails, retention-adjusted economics, and 24-month cohort contribution margin performance.

Important context

This is an individual contributor role. There is no team to start and no expectation of building one in the near term. You should be excited to get your hands dirty pulling data, building systems, and shipping dashboards yourself.

The Mission

Architect and operate the intelligence system that guides Freebird’s growth engine.

Ensure Freebird grows profitably by aligning how we acquire customers with how they perform over time.

In a subscription business, growth is driven by customers, retention, and contribution margin. Paid media impacts CAC. Creative impacts performance. Ecommerce impacts CVR and AOV. Retention impacts churn. Finance owns margin inputs.

Left unaligned, this creates drift.

You will connect these systems by building a unified measurement and decision layer that links spend, cohort behavior, retention, payback, and contribution margin into a single economic view that leadership can act on.

What You’ll Do

Scale acquisition profitably

  • Guide and optimize spend so it scales efficiently under contribution margin guardrails
  • Define CAC ceilings tied to 12- and 24-month contribution margin
  • Model diminishing returns and marginal efficiency curves to inform budget allocation
  • Translate attribution constraints and measurement uncertainty into practical, decision-ready frameworks
  • Interpret insights from MMM, incrementality tests, lift studies, or MTA frameworks and translate them into practical budget and investment decisions
  • Identify which channels, audiences, creatives, and offers drive the highest-quality cohorts
  • Support structured validation of new channels before meaningful scale
  • Deliver clear monthly recommendations on where to scale, hold, or cut

Increase 24-month contribution margin per cohort

  • Build and maintain 12- and 24-month contribution margin tracking by acquisition cohort
  • Develop survival curve diagnostics and retention performance visibility across key milestones
  • Operationalize retention-adjusted CAC and payback thinking into acquisition decisions
  • Identify acquisition sources that degrade churn, payback, LTV, or margin
  • Evaluate pricing, discounts, and offers against downstream margin impact
  • Create cohort-based forecasting views that improve decision quality without turning this role into FP&A

Own measurement infrastructure and dashboards (a meaningful early focus)

  • Own tracking health across ad platforms, GA4, server-side events, ecommerce, and subscription systems
  • Standardize UTMs, taxonomy, and core metric definitions so performance reporting is trusted
  • Partner with Finance to align revenue, refunds, COGS, and contribution margin inputs
  • Build automated dashboards and reduce manual reporting
  • Create a clear source of truth for acquisition efficiency and long-term cohort performance

Analyze experimentation and performance changes (not designing experiments)

  • Analyze tests and performance shifts across pricing, trial structure, billing cadence, onboarding, churn interventions, win-back, and upsell
  • Provide decision criteria rooted in long-term contribution margin, not isolated metric lifts
  • Deliver clear narratives on what changed, why it changed, and what to do next

What Success Looks Like

  • Marketing efficiency improves year over year
  • Spend scales confidently under clear contribution margin guardrails
  • 24-month contribution margin per cohort increases materially
  • Retention-adjusted CAC becomes a core decision metric
  • Forecasts and dashboards are trusted across Growth and Finance
  • Growth decisions become proactive rather than reactive
  • Manual reporting is substantially reduced through automation and systemization

Requirements

Must-haves

  • Strong track record as a hands-on, high-output analytics operator in growth, marketing analytics, or subscription analytics
  • Deep fluency in cohort behavior, retention curves, LTV, payback, and contribution margin economics
  • Strong paid media analytics foundation and understanding of attribution limitations
  • Advanced SQL and ability to build scalable dashboards (BI proficiency)
  • Comfort operating in scrappy environments where some reporting starts in spreadsheets and gets systemized over time
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: you can explain, debate, and align without being rigid or defensive
  • Intellectual humility and openness to having assumptions challenged

  • Bias toward execution: you ship, iterate, and improve systems continuously

  • Exposure to MMM, incrementality testing, lift studies, or MTA frameworks and experience translating those insights into marketing investment decisions
  • Experience linking creative and acquisition inputs to downstream cohort quality
  • Experience working closely with Finance inputs without turning the role into FP&A

This role is not a fit if

  • You are primarily looking to manage a team rather than do the work
  • You want an environment with extensive resourcing or fully mature data systems on day one
  • You prefer presenting strategy without owning the build and execution

Benefits

  • Autonomy with support: real responsibility paired with strong leadership
  • Remote-first and flexible: work with trust, autonomy, and accountability
  • No politics, just execution: a fast-moving, results-driven culture
  • Make your mark: help scale a 9-figure brand entering its next phase of growth
  • Kind and people-focused: we communicate openly, collaborate deeply, and support one another
  • Growth mindset: we embrace change, never settle, and continuously improve
  • Bias for action: we move fast, keep things simple, and innovate without fear

Virtasant is a global technology services company delivering large-scale cloud, data, and engineering solutions across 130+ countries. We partner with some of the world’s largest organizations to help them build, operate, and scale internal platforms used by tens of thousands of engineers.

For this role, you will be supporting one of the most advanced internal developer platforms in the world, powering products used by hundreds of millions of people. The problems you will solve are deep, complex, and essential to keeping a global-scale organization moving.

The Role

We are hiring an SRE Support Engineer who is exceptionally strong in:

Linux fundamentals

Linux networking

Containerization (Docker)

Kubernetes (internal/private cloud, multi-form experience preferred)

This is a hands-on, engineering-level support role focused on helping internal developers adopt, debug, and succeed with the client’s internal compute platform. You’ll work at the intersection of Kubernetes, containers, and low-level Linux troubleshooting, engaging directly with engineers to resolve issues that often require deep system understanding.

Platform & Customer Support

Troubleshoot, isolate, and resolve issues across:

  • Kubernetes workloads, scheduling, services, networking, RBAC

Cross-Team Collaboration

Operational Excellence

  • Uphold a strong emphasis on detail, organization, independence, and quality.

  • Contribute to building tools, scripts, and processes that improve support efficiency.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Technical

  • Strong Linux fundamentals (processes, services, filesystem, kernel basics).

  • Strong Docker/containerization expertise.

  • Experience in production support for large-scale systems.

Software & Scripting

  • Ability to write and understand Python scripts (or similar languages).

Communication & Work Style

Preferred

At Technatomy, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customer’s success. We provide solutions to agencies and entities including the Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of Defense, Defense Logistics Agency, National Institute of Health, and more. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

The Senior Proposal Lead is a senior growth professional responsible for leading complex, high-visibility federal proposal efforts that support Technatomy’s strategic expansion across multiple contract vehicles and agencies. This role provides end-to-end leadership of the proposal lifecycle, ensuring disciplined execution from opportunity qualification through submission and post-award analysis. The Senior Proposal Lead integrates capture strategy, structured proposal methodology, content development, compliance governance, and production oversight to deliver compliant, compelling, and competitive submissions. This position combines strategic thinking with hands-on authorship, shaping contributed technical and operational material into cohesive, evaluator-focused narratives that clearly articulate value, differentiation, and execution credibility.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Proposal Leadership & Lifecycle Management

  • Lead full lifecycle proposal development efforts from pre-RFP shaping and qualification through final submission and debrief analysis.
  • Translate capture strategies and win themes into actionable proposal plans, storyboards, and annotated outlines.
  • Develop and manage detailed proposal schedules, milestone calendars, writing assignments, and review timelines.
  • Establish and maintain comprehensive compliance matrices ensuring traceability of all solicitation requirements.
  • Perform in-depth solicitation analysis to identify risks, evaluation drivers, discriminators, and content gaps.
  • Facilitate structured proposal kickoffs to align contributors around strategy, compliance expectations, and quality standards.
  • Provide guidance to leadership regarding proposal readiness, resource alignment, and pursuit strategy refinement.

Content Development & Authorship

  • Drive disciplined application of Shipley-based methodologies across planning, drafting, reviewing, and finalization phases.
  • Directly author selected sections requiring strategic positioning, narrative integration, or recovery of underdeveloped content.
  • Transform contributed technical and operational material into structured, persuasive narratives aligned with evaluation priorities.
  • Ensure consistent integration of proof points, metrics, past performance relevance, and value statements throughout volumes.
  • Maintain voice consistency, narrative cohesion, and executive-level polish across all volumes.

Review Discipline & Quality Control

  • Lead Pink, Red, and Gold Team reviews with clearly defined objectives, scoring tools, and structured feedback mechanisms.
  • Evaluate proposal readiness and content quality against evaluation criteria and competitive positioning.
  • Drive resolution of review findings, enforce corrective actions, and validate final content prior to submission.
  • Ensure strict adherence to page limitations, formatting standards, submission instructions, and version control protocols.
  • Oversee graphics development to ensure visual elements reinforce strategic messaging and clarity.

Production, Knowledge Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate final production activities including formatting, proofreading, packaging, and electronic submission validation.
  • Maintain and enhance proposal templates, boilerplate content, compliance tools, and reusable artifacts.
  • Capture and document lessons learned following submissions and debriefs to strengthen future competitiveness.
  • Mentor proposal contributors on structured writing, compliance discipline, and effective narrative development

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

  • Five or more years of progressive federal proposal development experience.
  • Demonstrated leadership of large, complex, multi-volume proposals under IDIQ, BPA, GWAC, or task order vehicles.
  • Proven ability to manage concurrent high-priority pursuits in deadline-driven environments.
  • Strong knowledge of federal acquisition processes, evaluation methodologies, and compliance expectations.
  • Demonstrated mastery of Shipley or equivalent structured proposal frameworks.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including large-document formatting, styles management, and production controls.
  • Ability to analyze evaluation criteria and tailor content strategically to scoring priorities.
  • Strong executive communication skills and ability to influence cross-functional teams.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS DESIRED:

  • Experience working with Federal agencies, particularly the Department of Veterans Affairs, is a plus.
  • APMP certification at Practitioner level or higher, or advanced Shipley certification, is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to elevate proposal quality across an organization through process refinement and review rigor.
  • Experience mentoring proposal managers, writers, and cross-functional contributors to strengthen enterprise proposal capability.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Communications, Business, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).

WORK SCHEDULE:

  • This position is expected to support standard business operations during the hours of 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time.
  • Flexibility to support extended hours during peak proposal periods, including evenings or weekends, may be required to meet submission deadlines.

WORK LOCATION:

·Remote

As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

This position requires U.S. citizenship.

At UpCloud, you’ll be literally building the cloud.

We’re on a mission to be the number #1 European cloud platform, built on performance, reliability, and trust. While data sovereignty has become a hot topic in the EU, we can proudly say that we’ve been mastering it since 2011.

Sometimes, cloud technologies can be offered as a patchwork of ready-made solutions. At UpCloud, however, you'll be working with something that we've built from the ground up!

At the speeding pace our business is growing, we need new hands on deck! We are looking for a SeniorData Engineer to join our small but skilled BI team at the very intersection of code (Engineer), understanding the business (BI), and structuring data (Modeling).

You will be a key influencer in deciding the future of our data infrastructure and how it supports our strategic business areas.

In this job, you will:

  • Dedicate ~60% of your time to the programming side: building our data platform, developing ETL processes, managing DAGs, and ensuring our data formation is robust and reliable.

  • Spend ~30% of your time as a Data Analyst, breaking down business questions from Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Product Managers into actionable data models straight into DAGs.

  • Work closely with all our relevant internal stakeholders to ensure they have the data they need to drive UpCloud’s growth.

  • Organize and take ownership of our in-house systems to make data more accessible and useful for every user in the company.

To succeed, you’ll need:

  • Relevant software engineering experience, with strong skills in Python and SQL

  • Advanced experience with GCP (BigQuery), ideally with other cloud data environments or on-prem platforms.

  • Strong experience with data analysis architecture and managing DAGs using tools like Airflow and dbt.

  • A "Builder" Mindset: you’re a pragmatic and experienced professional who knows how to build a data platform, confident in creating efficient structures from scratch while setting the practices to maintain them.

  • Excellentcommunication skills: you’re comfortable switching between active collaboration with lead engineers in the company and translating "tech-speak" for non-technical stakeholders. You proactively seek out information from your teammates.

  • Pragmatism: A delivery-focused approach where you "get your hands dirty" in a smaller, fast-paced team, instead of waiting for things to arrive at you.

We also appreciate:

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • A background as a Data Engineer, Data Scientist, or Data Analyst who has transitioned/is transitioning into business-centric roles.

  • Previous experience in small data teams where you had to wear multiple hats and own the platform, from architecture to operation.

Why join UpCloud?

UpCloud is in an exciting phase right now, on track for massive growth in the cloud market. We offer a chance to be part of something big, where you can really make a difference! With our awesome team, products, and excellent positioning in the European cloud scene, UpCloud is in the perfect spot for anyone who wants to learn, grow, and shape the future of cloud tech.

You get to join a driven, highly motivated team committed to making a difference. We have a unique market opportunity in Europe with our strong local infrastructure because our biggest competitors are all US-based, which is what makes this such a captivating opportunity to learn and grow.

The pay range for this role is around 5500-6500 euros per month, depending on your seniority and location. The range is not set in stone, as we assess each case individually.

We review all applications and get back to all our candidates. That is a promise.

Benefits

  • Flexible and remote-friendly culture

  • Occupational healthcare

  • Travel insurance

  • Sports benefit

  • Company events and activities

This position plays a key role in analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing changes to improve overall site performance. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, web developers, and other team members.

Your responsibilities will include developing Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) strategies for our clients, auditing their websites to identify optimization opportunities, running A/B and multivariate tests to determine the changes needed, and working with our internal teams to execute, monitor, and further improve the results of the optimizations implemented.

Mission Statement:

The primary mission of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is to drive measurable improvements in our clients’ e-commerce website performance by implementing tailored CRO strategies. This will involve working directly on optimizing brand websites and using data-driven insights to enhance user experiences, maximize conversion rates, and deliver real business growth to our clients.

General responsibilities:

The responsibilities of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert include, but are not limited to:

  • Developing and implementing tailored, data-driven backend CRO strategies for our agency’s clients to enhance their website performance and maximize conversion rates
  • Performing thorough brand audits of clients’ websites to identify areas for improvement
  • Conducting in-depth analysis of user behavior using analytical CRO tools, user feedback, heatmaps, and session recordings to identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Designing, executing, and managing A/B and multivariate tests to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of the CRO changes implemented
  • Optimizing brands’ landing and product pages, checkout flows, and overall website architecture
  • Collaborating closely with copywriters, designers, and developers to implement best practices and innovative solutions that enhance the user experience and reduce funnel friction points
  • Monitoring and reporting on the performance of CRO initiatives, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Translating complex data and test results into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for clients to ensure that they can make informed decisions
  • Staying up-to-date with the latest trends and tools in the CRO, e-commerce, and digital marketing industries to continuously refine your own strategies and practices
  • Maintaining thorough documentation of all CRO projects, including test results and client interactions, to track progress and outcomes
  • Assisting in the development of CRO case studies and success stories for marketing purposes

Overall, the Conversion Rate Optimization Expert will play an important role in driving measurable growth for our clients by leveraging data-driven insights to optimize their online presence, enhance user experiences, and ultimately increase conversion rates across their e-commerce platforms.

Position specifications:

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position includes committing to the following:

  • Full-time commitment while overlapping with our standard office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Consistently maintaining an average workload of 40 hours per week
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • A 30-day notice period of one calendar month

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

As our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert, you need to bring a highly proactive and analytical approach to your work. You should be able to work independently with high levels of reliability, transparency, and trust. You also need the ability to work under pressure and manage multiple clients’ CRO strategies with great attention to detail and the required technical abilities. The ideal person for this role is a rational thinker who enjoys problem-solving, who can work fast and efficiently, and who has excellent communication skills. In addition, good organizational, time management, and analytical skills will help you succeed in this position and work well within our team environment.

Availability and consistency are highly important factors for us, so our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert should display these qualities regarding workload commitments and availability during office hours.

Key traits for this position:

You should demonstrate great attention to detail, strong communication skills, as well as excellent analytical, technical, and problem-solving abilities. A sense of proactivity, hunger for growth, and a consistent, highly communicative work ethic will work in your favor. You will also need a forward-thinking approach to anticipate shifts in user feedback and industry trends, and you should be highly adaptable and open to continuous learning to help you stay ahead in the rapidly evolving e-commerce landscape.

Responsiveness and autonomy will be essential traits for this role.

Key requirements:

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position has the following key requirements:

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in the CRO field
  • Proven experience in a similar CRO role, specifically within the e-commerce industry
  • A proven track record of improving conversion rates for e-commerce clients
  • Proficiency in analytical tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and Convert.com as well as excellent data analysis skills to provide actionable insights to our clients
  • A strong understanding of UX/UI principles and how they affect conversion rates
  • A demonstrated ability to run A/B and multivariate tests from start to finish
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms (such as Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce) and the specific challenges involved in optimizing the user’s experience
  • Being familiar with heatmaps, session recordings, and user feedback tools
  • Strong communication skills for effectively presenting test results and recommendations to the team and the clients (direct client communication will not be a requirement of the role, at least not as originally intended)
  • A proactive attitude with a strong focus on delivering high-quality results
  • Being able to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team
  • Being able to handle multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • An excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to finding solutions
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your own time independently and effectively
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language)
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it
  • Must be available and responsive during our office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Must be able to consistently work full-time

You will translate complex business processes into AI-driven workflows, define integration blueprints, and guide customers through their transformation to autonomous AI agents.

raw.description:
SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER or PROJECT MANAGER

Role: This posting is for either a Senior Project Manager or a Project Manager
Positions Open: 2

POSITION SUMMARY

The Project Manager role is responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of large-scale fiber optic construction projects across multiple markets. The position will oversee project timelines, budgets, permitting, vendor coordination, and customer communications to ensure successful fiber deployments that meet operational and financial targets. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in OSP fiber construction, strong organizational and communication skills, and the ability to manage complex projects independently in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identification of candidate OSP engineering/construction firms, managing bid/vendor selection process and contract negotiation
  • Tactical project management, including managing project schedules, running regular project calls and performing support project functions (such as securing bonds, internal signatures for permits, etc.)
  • Providing build cost estimates for sales team
  • Performing service delivery functions, including providing regular customer updates (written and/or oral), coordinating site access, and close out package preparation
  • Performing site walks with customers and vendors
  • Working with local/state/federal permitting agencies to secure timely permit approvals
  • Providing direction and coordination of project environmental requirements, tasks, and activities
  • Managing environmental engineering vendors and related subcontractors as they secure related permitting
  • Documenting splicing requirements and maintaining fiber engineering documentation
  • Specifying and procuring optics components for contractor installation
  • Maintaining up-to-date network maps in Vero’s proprietary geospatial project management platform, including in-flight design changes and final as-built routes
  • Providing accurate network maps to state 811 agencies and Vero Networks NOC
  • Managing network maintenance and relocation projects (including emergency maintenance)

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in project management, fiber network engineering, or telecom infrastructure deployment
    • Project Manager level 5+ years of experience
    • Senior Project Manager level 10+ years of experience
  • Proven ability to develop and manage detailed project schedules, budgets, and scopes of work
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Excellent vendor management and communication skills, with experience running RFPs, selecting contractors, and negotiating terms
  • Demonstrated experience with OSP fiber project management, including permitting, construction oversight, and service delivery coordination
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and mapping tools (e.g., Google Earth or similar GIS platforms)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field
  • Familiarity with environmental permitting processes and regulations
  • Experience using or managing data in proprietary geospatial or project management platforms
  • Working knowledge of fiber optic equipment, network architecture, and splicing documentation
  • Experience supporting state 811 programs, NOC coordination, and network maintenance or relocation efforts

JOB DETAILS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • This role requires occasional travel up to 10% of the time for activities such as out-of-town meetings, training, or outreach activities.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States.
  • This is a staff position.
  • This is an Exempt position.
  • This is a Full-Time position.
  • This is a Remote position.
  • The schedule for this position is Monday through Friday with occasional weekend availability as needed to fulfill the core duties of the role.
  • This position requires the ability to sit and work at a desk for extended periods of time, using a computer and other office equipment.
  • This position requires the ability to perform fine motor tasks, such as typing or using a mouse, for extended period of time.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

  • Base pay is paid at an annual salary rate.
    • The range for the project manager position is $80,000 to $110,000 depending on experience.
    • The range for the senior project manager position is $110,000 to $130,000 depending on experience.
  • Target annual bonus for this role is 10%.
  • Paid life insurance, short-term disability insurance, paid medical plans, PTO, holidays.
  • Dental and vision options.
  • 401(k) with match.

ABOUT VERO

Vero was founded in 2017 with a focus on bridging the digital divide by serving schools and libraries in unserved and underserved areas. We have also established a fiber to the premises business that directly serves residential and small business customers in underserved regions. In addition, we now serve a small subset of large business and wholesale customers - which we typically use as a springboard for our consumer focused services for underserved communities. Our management team brings decades of experience in building and operating fiber networks for various customer segments, including residential, business, and wholesale clients.

NOTICES

Vero participates in E-Verify. Vero will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization. For more information about E-Verify, please visit: www.e-verify.gov

This position requires the ability to pass a standard background check upon offer of position.

At least 2 professional references are required.


Vero Networks uses the JazzHR platform for applicant tracking. Applicants may receive legitimate interview requests from an @applytojob.com email address. Vero also utilizes AI screeners for certain roles and may request that applicants complete an initial screening via RoundOneAI.

raw.excerpt: Driven by Innovation and built on Trust, rockITdata is a unique SDVOSB services company that partners with leading commercial healthcare/life sciences organizations on cutting edge innovations - think AI, automation and data transformation.
raw.description:
Driven by Innovation and built on Trust, rockITdata is a unique SDVOSB services company that partners with leading commercial healthcare/life sciences organizations on cutting edge innovations - think AI, automation and data transformation. We then bring those commercially tested solutions to government entities to deliver predictable, measurable impact for the American taxpayer and consumer.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Full Stack Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both data engineering and software development, with expertise in building end-to-end data solutions. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on diverse data projects and contribute to the development of innovative data-driven applications. This is a Remote position.

Key Responsibilities
  • Data Ingestion and Integration:
    • Design and implement scalable data ingestion pipelines to efficiently collect and process data from various sources.
    • Integrate data from different systems and platforms to create unified datasets for analysis and reporting.
  • Data Storage and Management:
    • Develop and maintain data storage solutions such as data lakes, data warehouses, and NoSQL databases.
    • Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Data Processing and Transformation:
    • Implement data processing workflows for cleaning, transforming, and enriching raw data into usable formats.
    • Apply data transformation techniques such as ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes.
  • Data Modeling and Optimization:
    • Design and implement data models to support analytical and reporting requirements.
    • Optimize data models for query performance, data integrity, and storage efficiency.
  • Software Development and Integration:
    • Build software applications and APIs to expose data services and functionality to other systems and applications.
    • Integrate data engineering workflows with existing software systems and platforms.
  • Monitoring and Maintenance:
    • Establish monitoring and alerting mechanisms to track the health and performance of data pipelines and systems.
    • Conduct regular maintenance activities to ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of data infrastructure.
  • Documentation and Collaboration:
    • Document data engineering processes, architectures, and solutions to facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions.



Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala for data engineering and software development.
  • Expert-level skills in data visualization platforms beyond Tableau and Power BI (e.g. Qlik)
  • Strong understanding of database concepts, data modeling techniques, and SQL programming.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP for building and deploying data solutions.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and technologies (e.g., Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake).
  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and software development best practices (e.g., Agile, CI/CD).


Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building solutions for Commercial clients in Pharma, Biotech, CPG, Retail or Manufacturing industries.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of streaming data processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Flink, Apache Kafka Streams).
  • Familiarity with data governance and security practices for protecting sensitive data.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex data engineering issues.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

Value People Above All Else.

Transparency to a Fault.

Progress, Not Perfection.

Be Good by Doing Good.

Smart People Can Disagree.

Bend but Don’t Break.

Represent Your Brand.

Think Differently.

Be Amazing, Be Fearless, Smile, Have Fun!

raw.description:
D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift.

New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.

D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.

D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.

Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.

ABOUT THIS ROLE:

We are looking for an application troubleshooting analyst – an individual who can perform analysis of a given problem report and determine where the problem is, its cause, solution or recommend effective workaround where applicable.

Acting as an escalation point for client Subject Matter Experts, Product Support Analysts act as the primary point of contact for client technical teams. Through a combination of technical investigation and troubleshooting, as well as collaborating with teams across D2L, PSAs offer a world class support experience for D2L Administratorswith varying degrees of technical expertise across the Enterprise, Higher Education, and K-12 segments.

Successful candidates must have strong analytical skills and be creative problem solvers. They will be able to make accurate risk assessments and demonstrate above-average attention to details and competencies. They are excellent communicators and are comfortable discussing technical issues with clients whose technical expertise may vary.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Utilize electronic communication by chat, phone, email, or assignment through case tracking system to interact with users facing technical issues, effectively identifying and documenting the problems they are encountering
  • Conduct thorough research and implement appropriate solutions by referring to user guides, technical manuals, and other relevant documents
  • Identify and correct improperly configured installations
  • Replicate, diagnose, and resolve technical problems experienced by users, employing troubleshooting techniques to ensure prompt resolution
  • Create, update, and resolve support cases within defined Service Level Objectives
  • Improve product/tool design and functionality through creation of Software Defect reports and Feature Enhancement reports
  • Create Support documentation, including FAQs and both internal and client-facing Knowledge-based Articles
  • Participate in collaborative troubleshooting sessions to identify root causes of complex issues
  • Participate in a shift rotation including weekdays, evenings, and weekends based on Eastern Time
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Manager

WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE ROLE:

  • Fluency in English and one of Spanish or Brazilian Portuguese is required

Desired Competencies:

  • Ability to learn and adapt to new tools and products quickly
  • Strong ability to recognize patterns
  • Ability to work individually and in collaboration with colleagues
  • Ability to work well in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrable ability to multitask both independently and within a team
  • Ability to identifying trends and make suggestions for technical modifications to resolve existing and future problems
  • Excellent research capabilities

Desired Skills:

  • Strong ability to write, interpret, and debug SQL queries on demand
  • Working knowledge of
    • Web services (SOAP and REST), XML, HTML, ASP, ASPX, C#, .NET, JAVA, JavaScript, and Microsoft tools and technologies
    • Active Directory, Office 365 Suites, OAuth, LDAP, and SAML solutions.
    • Web applications and how they work at a high level (web servers, database servers, client-to-server communication)
    • Wireshark, Fiddler, and other browser based diagnostic and reporting tools
  • Communicate technical and complex information in verbal and written form
  • Strong customer service skills
  • Keen attention to detail and organization skills
  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills
  • Excellent problem-solving and navigational skills

Desired Experience:

  • Experience working with Microsoft SQL
  • Some experience providing customer service
  • Relevant work experience in a similar role
    • Experience working in a Helpdesk environment is considered an asset
  • LMS experience – user, administration, and/or support is considered an asset
  • Experience with Salesforce or any other ticketing system is an asset

Education Recommendations:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent technical experience

This position is to fill an existing vacancy

The expected base salary range for a new hire in this role is listed below. The annualized base salary offered is determined by each candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, education, training and experience. It is aligned to ensure both internal and external competitiveness using market data for the geographic location and industry. As part of the total compensation at D2L the role may be eligible for additional benefits including a Wellness Subsidy, Equity Grants, Variable Incentive, and more.

Base Salary Range
$55,000—$65,000 CAD

Don’t meet every single requirement? We strongly encourage you to still apply! At D2L, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage your application even if you don't believe you meet every single qualification outlined, because we love to help our people grow and develop!

Why we're awesome:

At D2L, we are dedicated to providing you with the tools to do the best work of your life. While some of our perks and benefits may vary depending on location or employment type, we are proud to provide employees with the following through #LifeAtD2L:

  • Impactful work transforming the way the world learns
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Learning and Growth opportunities
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $4,000 CAD for continuing education through our Catch the Wave Program
  • 2 Paid Days off for Catch the Wave related activities like exams or final assignments
  • Employee wellbeing (Access to mental health services, EFAP program, financial planning and more)
  • Retirement planning
  • 2 Paid Volunteer Days
  • Competitive Benefits Package
  • Home Internet Reimbursements
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Wellness Reimbursement
  • Employee Recognition
  • Social Events
  • Dog Friendly Offices at our HQ in Kitchener, Winnipeg, Vancouver and Melbourne.

We are looking for a highly motivated Associate Strategic Accounts Director, Pharma and Biotech to join our team!

You will be a key member of the Strategic Accounts team supporting the VP, Finance and Business Development in executing Ultima’s strategy in enabling large-scale data generation and engaging with biotech and pharma accounts. This role will report to the VP, Finance and Business Development.

  • Develop, negotiate, and execute commercial agreements, including collaborations, licensing deals, and other strategic business models, that accelerate revenue growth and market penetration

  • BS in life sciences, business, or related field required; advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) is strongly preferred

You'll manage high-budget campaigns and deliver record-breaking performance for our brand partners while scaling our agency through strategic lead generation campaigns.

What You'll Do:

Client Campaign Management:

  • Manage and optimize TikTok ad campaigns, driving maximum ROAS for D2C brands across feed ads, spark ads, live shopping ads, and product shopping ads.
  • Scale Meta advertising campaigns (Facebook & Instagram) using proven TikTok-to-Meta playbooks, leveraging winning creative and audience strategies across both platforms.
  • Run continuous A/B tests on creative, audiences, placements, and bidding strategies across TikTok and Meta to improve performance and scale profitably.
  • Analyze campaign data daily across both platforms to identify opportunities and optimize key metrics including ROAS, CPA, CTR, and conversion rates.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to develop high-performing ad concepts and provide data-driven feedback on what's working across TikTok and Meta formats.
  • Adjust budgets, bids, and targeting in real-time to maximize performance while minimizing wasted spend on both platforms.

Agency Growth:

  • Design and execute lead generation campaigns across Meta to attract enterprise and celebrity brand partners.
  • Test and optimize agency acquisition funnels, landing pages, and lead magnets to drive qualified inbound opportunities.
  • Track and report on agency marketing ROI, cost per lead, and lead-to-client conversion rates.

Strategic Collaboration:

  • Partner with Account Managers to align paid media with organic and affiliate strategies for cohesive brand growth.
  • Stay ahead of TikTok and Meta platform updates, beta features, and advertising best practices to maintain competitive advantages

What You Need:

  • 2-4 years in paid social media buying with hands-on TikTok Ads Manager and Meta Ads Manager experience
  • Proven track record managing $100K+ monthly ad budgets for e-commerce brands across TikTok and Meta
  • Experience with B2B lead generation or agency marketing campaigns (preferred but not required)
  • Strong grasp of performance metrics: ROAS, CPA, CAC, LTV, CTR, CPL
  • Proficiency with TikTok Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and reporting tools
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting performance and strategy to clients
  • Creative eye for identifying winning ad concepts and adapting them cross-platform
  • Highly organized with ability to manage multiple high-budget accounts plus internal campaigns
  • Passion for performance marketing, platform trends, and growth marketing

What Success Looks Like:

  • Consistently exceed client ROAS targets while maintaining clients Top 10 partner status.
  • Successfully scale TikTok campaigns to Meta, achieving profitable expansion across both platforms.
  • Generate qualified agency leads at target CPL while optimizing conversion rates through the sales funnel.
  • Develop innovative testing strategies that uncover breakthrough audiences and creative approaches.
  • Proactively identify optimization opportunities and scale campaigns profitably.
  • Build trusted client relationships through transparent reporting and strategic insights.

The Team:

You'll collaborate with Account Managers, Creative teams, Affiliate specialists, and a Shop Operations team under our founding leadership. We're performance-driven and results-focused, maintaining our Top 10 ranking through constant innovation and testing. Everyone contributes ideas and insights to drive record-breaking results.

The Culture:

  • Performance Pioneers – Challenge conventional wisdom, test innovative strategies, and constantly seek improvements that exceed benchmarks.
  • Data-Driven Winners – Make decisions based on metrics and statistical significance, not gut feelings. Track everything and optimize relentlessly.
  • Brand Obsessed – Communicate clearly with clients, exceed their expectations, and build the trusted partnerships that make us the preferred TikTok Shop partner.
